rules.description: Card validations counted on the vehicle (card_taps) exceed the ticket records stored for the trip
Ticket without a route ID
Trip without a route ID
Ticket tap-in or tap-out stop does not exist in stops
Delay recorded at a stop that does not exist in stops
More than one row with the same ticket_id (duplicate transaction)
More than one row with the same trip_id
Negative passenger count
Timestamp that cannot be parsed (row was quarantined at ingestion)
Actual arrival more than impossible_time_gap_hours away from the scheduled arrival
Trip actual arrival more than impossible_time_gap_hours away from the scheduled arrival
Departure from the stop recorded before the arrival at it
Trip arrives at the last stop before it departed from the first
Peak load above capacity_violation_factor x the vehicle's design capacity
Delay value that is not numeric or outside the valid range
Trip without a vehicle
Stop sequence of a route direction is not exactly 1..n (gap or repeated number)
Route distance not positive or implausibly large
Ticket for a passenger ID that is not registered
Trip IDs referenced by counts/tickets/delays/GPS but absent from trips (child rows are flagged)
Trip operated by a vehicle not present in vehicles
Tap-in time outside the timestamp_date_window_days around the service date
Stop coordinates outside the operating area
Negative fare amount
Trip for a route ID not present in routes
